task: MVCC transactional key-value store (ae.mvcc) with snapshot/serializable isolation, vacuum and oracle tests
reasoning_summary: Versions per key sorted by commit timestamp; transactions buffer writes and validate at commit under one store lock (first-committer-wins, plus read-set and scanned-range validation for SERIALIZABLE). Vacuum uses the oldest active start timestamp as watermark. Tests include a seeded differential run against a copy-the-map model and mutation checks of watermark, range validation and tombstone removal.
